_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/test_triggered_split_mana.py. t_tsm_wyrm is the Klauth line in full -- an attacks trigger that adds X mana freely divided among the five colours, spendable only on spells, surviving every step and phase boundary until end of turn. t_tsm_ritual is the same trigger with no restriction, the control that proves the assertions are about the restriction and not about effect-made mana. t_tsm_relic is the activated ability the restricted mana may not pay for and t_tsm_bolt is the spell it may; both cost {1}, so the only difference between them is what the mana is being spent on.

cards.name: Test Hoard Wyrm
cards.oracle_text:
Flying
Whenever Test Hoard Wyrm attacks, add X mana in any combination of colors, where X is the total power of attacking creatures. Spend this mana only to cast spells. Until end of turn, you don't lose this mana as steps and phases end.
